title: Voice discovery on television
slide_intent: Show a conversational request in context so viewers understand what they can ask a service to do.
strategic_value: A short entertainment request can make Xfinity’s voice interaction feel approachable and directly useful.
demonstration: A television frame overlays a quoted request to find something new on Peacock above a film image and playback progress.
practical_value: Use a realistic request alongside the resulting content to demonstrate a voice feature without a long explanation.

content_islands.name: Spoken request
content_islands.spec: Place the small voice icon and quoted request along the top of the screen.

content_islands.name: Entertainment result
content_islands.spec: Fill the screen with the film scene while retaining the title and playback line near the bottom.

content_islands.name: Physical frame
content_islands.spec: Keep the dark screen edge and warm surrounding wall visible to establish the television setting.

reference_purposes.Application: A quoted discovery request is presented directly on a television playback example.
